import math, os

OUT = "/home/kernel-kain/Documents/Github/chesspulse/demo/article"
BG, SURF, LINE = "#0e1012", "#161a1d", "#262c31"
TEXT, MUTED = "#e9e7e3", "#98a0a6"
PULSE, BL, BD = "#5ac8d8", "#d8d0c0", "#55636b"
FONT = "Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif"
MONO = "'JetBrains Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Consolas, monospace"


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")


class Svg:
    def __init__(self, w, h):
        self.w, self.h = w, h
        self.parts = []

    def rect(self, x, y, w, h, fill=SURF, stroke=LINE, rx=10, sw=2, dash=None, op=1):
        d = f' stroke-dasharray="{dash}"' if dash else ""
        self.parts.append(
            f'<rect x="{x}" y="{y}" width="{w}" height="{h}" rx="{rx}" fill="{fill}" '
            f'stroke="{stroke}" stroke-width="{sw}"{d} opacity="{op}"/>'
        )

    def text(self, x, y, s, size=24, fill=TEXT, weight=400, anchor="start", font=FONT):
        self.parts.append(
            f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" font-size="{size}" fill="{fill}" font-weight="{weight}" '
            f'text-anchor="{anchor}" font-family="{font}">{esc(s)}</text>'
        )

    def line(self, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=MUTED, sw=3, dash=None, arrow=True):
        d = f' stroke-dasharray="{dash}"' if dash else ""
        m = ' marker-end="url(#arr)"' if arrow else ""
        self.parts.append(
            f'<line x1="{x1}" y1="{y1}" x2="{x2}" y2="{y2}" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="{sw}"{d}{m}/>'
        )

    def raw(self, s):
        self.parts.append(s)

    def save(self, name):
        head = (
            f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{self.w}" height="{self.h}" '
            f'viewBox="0 0 {self.w} {self.h}">'
            '<defs><marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="8" '
            f'markerHeight="8" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="{MUTED}"/></marker></defs>'
            f'<rect width="{self.w}" height="{self.h}" fill="{BG}"/>'
        )
        with open(os.path.join(OUT, name), "w") as f:
            f.write(head + "".join(self.parts) + "</svg>")


# ---------- 1. Cover, 2000 x 840 (DEV shows 1000 x 420; this is 2x) ----------
c = Svg(2000, 840)
sq = 105
for r in range(8):
    for col in range(8):
        fill = TEXT if (r + col) % 2 == 0 else BD
        c.rect(1160 + col * sq, r * sq, sq, sq, fill=fill, stroke="none", rx=0, op=0.07)
pts = []
for x in range(0, 2001, 4):
    p = (x % 210) / 210
    y = 640
    if 0.30 <= p < 0.34:
        y = 640 - 170 * math.sin((p - 0.30) / 0.04 * math.pi)
    elif 0.40 <= p < 0.45:
        y = 640 + 40 * math.sin((p - 0.40) / 0.05 * math.pi)
    y += 4 * math.sin(x / 23.0)
    pts.append(f"{x},{y:.1f}")
c.raw(
    f'<polyline points="{" ".join(pts)}" fill="none" stroke="{PULSE}" stroke-width="5" '
    f'stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.35"/>'
)
c.raw(
    f'<polyline points="{" ".join(pts)}" fill="none" stroke="{PULSE}" stroke-width="3" '
    f'stroke-linejoin="round"/>'
)
c.text(120, 300, "ChessPulse", size=160, weight=700)
c.text(124, 380, "Review the player, not only the moves.", size=56, fill=MUTED)
c.text(124, 450, "Pulse, clock, think time and mistakes on one timeline.", size=34, fill=MUTED)
c.text(124, 130, "LOCAL DESKTOP APP  ·  BULLET · BLITZ · RAPID", size=26, fill=PULSE, font=MONO)
c.save("cover.svg")

# ---------- 2. Three layers, 1600 x 860 ----------
t = Svg(1600, 860)
t.text(800, 70, "Three layers, one report", size=40, weight=700, anchor="middle")
t.text(800, 108, "Each layer gives one kind of evidence. Only the first two feed the report numbers.",
       size=22, fill=MUTED, anchor="middle")
cards = [
    (60, "1", "Pulse", "While you play, on this computer",
     ["Camera opens through the SmartSpectra SDK",
      "Each reading has a confidence score and a stable flag",
      "Baseline: median of the first 60 seconds",
      "Coverage: share of the session with usable readings",
      "Under 70% coverage, the report is refused"]),
    (540, "2", "Game review", "After you stop, Stockfish 19 at depth 12",
     ["Pasted PGNs are scored move by move",
      "Centipawn loss per move, split by pulse band",
      "Elevated: 10 bpm or more above baseline",
      "A band with fewer than 5 moves shows Insufficient",
      "Games are placed on the pulse timeline by their marks"]),

     ["Sends your question, PGNs and summary numbers",
      "Never sends video, images or raw pulse samples",
      "Reply is labelled INFERRED and shown as plain text",
      "Numbers the report does not hold are withheld",
      "No API key, no request"]),

---
title: ChessPulse: review the player, not only the moves
published: false
tags: presagechallenge, chess, electron, typescript
cover_image: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kernelKain/chesspulse/main/demo/article/cover.png
---

*This is a submission for the [Presage SmartSpectra SDK Challenge](https://dev.to/challenges/presage-2026-11-04)*

## What I Built

Most chess players know tilt. You lose a game, then another, and the next one is worse, because your head is still on the last one. Ten or fifteen games in one sitting is common for players who queue again right away. A bad run can cost more rating than the rest of the evening earns.

Chess.com can show you the moves that lost the game. It cannot show what you were like when you played them. The PGN for a calm blunder and the PGN for a rushed one look the same.

ChessPulse is a local desktop app that puts both on one timeline. It is built for bullet, blitz and rapid players, and it is free and open source. You play on chess.com while the app reads your pulse from the webcam through the Presage SmartSpectra SDK. Afterwards you paste your games, and the app scores your moves, lines them up with the pulse, and writes a report.

It works on three levels:

1. **Pulse.** The SmartSpectra SDK measures your pulse on your computer while you play.
2. **Game review.** Stockfish 19 scores every move of your pasted games locally, at depth 12.
3. **Explanation.** An optional AI reply answers your questions about the session. It reads only the summary numbers from the first two levels, and it is labelled as inferred text. The app works fully without an API key.

ChessPulse does not detect tilt, mood or stress, and it does not diagnose anything. It shows where your pulse and your mistakes happened together, and you decide what that means.

The report gives you:

- A summary header with your baseline pulse, the elevated threshold, pulse coverage and blunders. Each one has a plain definition next to it.
- One verdict line that says how many blunders happened and whether any of them came while your pulse was raised.
- The Pulse and Play timeline, with pulse, game boundaries, move loss and think time on one clock.
- Move Quality, overall and per game. Each large mistake links back to its place on the timeline.
- Accuracy for two pulse bands. "Settled" means your usual pulse. "Elevated" means 10 bpm or more above your baseline. A band with fewer than five scored moves shows "Insufficient" instead of a number.
- A short between-games note when your pulse stays raised after you mark a game as ended.
- A refusal, not a weak report, when the pulse signal covers less than 70% of the session.

## Demo

**Demo video:** [link to be added after recording]

The judges can check the live pulse signal in the video. Every report below comes from a real session captured on my machine. The project has no demo mode and no fixture path.

### Passed run: 10 bullet games

Session `01M829E6SVWDNHB7XH84E4TAZB`: 10 games at 1+0, 22 minutes 19 seconds, 88.2% pulse coverage, baseline 81.4 bpm, elevated threshold 91.4 bpm.

1. **Home.** The app lists the two example sessions under "Example sessions", apart from my own. Both are read-only.

   ![Home screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kernelKain/chesspulse/main/demo/screenshots/01-home.png)

2. **Setup.** The app checks the camera, the API key and the light. It asks for consent before it opens the camera. The camera stays off until I press "Allow the camera".

   ![Setup and consent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kernelKain/chesspulse/main/demo/screenshots/02-session-setup.png)

3. **Paste.** After I stopped sensing, I shared each game from chess.com as PGN with the clock timestamps turned on. Pasted games are checked before scoring.

   ![Paste PGNs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kernelKain/chesspulse/main/demo/screenshots/03-pgn-paste.png)
   ![Pasted games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kernelKain/chesspulse/main/demo/screenshots/04-pgn-paste-filled.png)
   ![Valid games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kernelKain/chesspulse/main/demo/screenshots/05-pgn-valid.png)

4. **Summary.** The report opens with the verdict: 3 blunders, none of them while my pulse was elevated. Settled accuracy was 91% over 216 moves. The elevated band had only 3 moves, so it shows "Insufficient". The summary also gives the wait between games 9 and 10 as 35 seconds, from the game marks I set.

   ![Report summary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kernelKain/chesspulse/main/demo/screenshots/08-report-summary-bullet.png)

5. **Timeline.** The pulse trace sits above the game bands, so I can see where each game starts and ends and what my pulse was doing at the time.

   ![Pulse and Play timeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kernelKain/chesspulse/main/demo/screenshots/09-pulse-and-play-timeline-bullet.png)

6. **Move Quality.** The report scored 242 moves. The largest losses are listed with links to the timeline.

   ![Move Quality](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kernelKain/chesspulse/main/demo/screenshots/10-move-quality-bullet.png)

7. **AI explainer.** This step is optional. Nothing is sent until I press "Generate explanation". The reply is shown as plain text, labelled INFERRED.
